_comment: Budget for the contract-size CI gate. See script/ci/check_contract_sizes.py.
Limits are the protocol constants: EIP-170 caps deployed runtime bytecode,
EIP-3860 caps initcode. fail_pct is the fraction of a limit a contract may reach
before CI fails, so the gate bites while there is still room to react rather than
at deploy time. warn_pct only annotates the report.
Add an entry to `overrides` to accept a contract above fail_pct. Runtime and initcode
are budgeted separately: set max_runtime_bytes, max_init_bytes, or both, since raising
one does not affect the other. An override is a recorded decision, not an exemption --
the ceiling still binds, so the contract cannot grow further without another deliberate
change here. Keep the reason current and delete the entry once the bytes are reclaimed.
